notes.title: What do you want to see next?
notes.content:
With the arrival of new players thanks to Steam rhythm fest, I'd love to hear your thoughts on what you'd like to see improved or added. Whether it's fresh songs, new features, song modifiers, or bug fixes. what changes would make your experience better?

Share your ideas in the comments or join our Discord to discuss them in more detail!

[url=https://discord.gg/ZA8cwr2nv5]Discord link[/url]

notes.title: Update V1.4.0
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] New Song: Sucker Punch by Falconite
[*] New Song: Viridian by Falconite
[*] New Modifier: Strobe, like flashlight the notes fade out but in this mode they all fade in and out at the same time. 
[*] New modifier: Judgement mode, turn on judgements to test yourself! (This will not affect your leader board or high score)
[*] Grace Period at the start of all songs. Now up till 0.05 seconds before the first note any ghost taps you do will no longer affect accuracy or lose health.
[*] 3 New Profile frames. Colour variants of the original 3 seasonal frames that are now available for completing 3,5 and 10 songs or more with S or higher.
[*] Added an import .OSZ option that helps make it easier to extract the .OSU file
[/list]

[b]Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] Songs that don't have custom loading screens will now use the default Rhythium loading screen instead of Dusk
[*] Each month of the year now has a set Season, this will no longer have any rewards but for those of you wanting to try the monthly challenge it's now available. 
[*] Profile frames for the support creator DLC now have an steam symbol next to them in the selection menu to make it easier to see where you get it from
[*] New Image for Starter Kit
[*] New Image for Car on a Walk
[*] The tool tip when looking at mods in the quick select menu is slightly larger to make it easier to read.
[*] The credits section has been updated with the new songs
[*] A full redesign of the convert song menu to utilise the space better and only show you relevant information. 
[*] For the folders: Import Folder, Export Folder, CustomSongs, Custom Song Converter and CustomSongBackground. If you try to open these via their respective button and the folder no longer exists it will create a new folder with that name. 
[*] 
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes/general fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a grammatical error in the song list
[*] Fixed the tool tip for Mirror Mode
[*] Opening a menu while listening to a song demo will no longer pause all music.
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause all judgements to award 100 points instead of 50 or 300
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the credits to sometimes open halfway down.
[*] Fixed a bug where the new High score text would not appear when achieving a new high score.
[*] Fixed a bug in the song converter, where if you had already converted that song before it would not throw up an error
[*] Fixed several instances where the text box was blocking part of an button
[/list]

notes.title: Announcing Rhythium x Falconite
notes.content:
I'm happy to announce the first set of post launch songs will be joining us soon. While they wont make it in time for season 3 they will be here soon.

For this Rhythium will be teaming up with the video game inspired electronic artist [url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/6L8Rxwpf9ExHUVwpqpYyZe?si=j8HAgkuVSXu47UN56i_uDQ]Falconite[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40967407/3a9cba5370c7203fff493d3e45eefa304fec1545.gif[/img]

Rhythium will be adding 3 new songs ranging in difficulty, including Falconites hit song Digital Baptism. This will push the official list of songs up to 20 and will release as two content drops. First Digital Baptism will drop by itself and then Sucker Punch and Viridian will drop together later. 

The full list includes 
[list]
[*]Digital Baptism
[*]Sucker Punch
[*]Viridian
[/list]

I can't wait to add the first set of post launch songs for all of you to enjoy and I hope this isn't the last set either! Please check [url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/6L8Rxwpf9ExHUVwpqpYyZe?si=j8HAgkuVSXu47UN56i_uDQ]Falconite[/url] out on [url=https://open.spotify.com/artist/6L8Rxwpf9ExHUVwpqpYyZe?si=j8HAgkuVSXu47UN56i_uDQ]Spotify[/url] and check out their [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCLLtm12IqDSYxJQOYR6HQrQ]Youtube [/url]channel.

notes.title: Patch v1.1.0
notes.content:
[b]Patch Notes - V 1.1.0[/b]

While patch v1.1.0 may be what seems a smaller update, this update has laid the foundation for allowing many more mods in the future. This allows me to make new mods easier and allows you all to select what mods are the most important too you for quick access.

As well as the important fix of not setting all backgrounds to black on default. If you have already played please go to Settings > Video > Background Opacity > 100% to fix this issue (unless you like the black background).

[b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
-Mirror Mode - A new Mod that will flip all the notes in the chart, Does not increase multiplier
-The Mod Menu - A full list of mods in the game which can be dragged onto a set of 8 quick slots.
-Mod Quick Access - The current 8 mod slots have become a quick acess allowing you to select what ones go there and what order

[b]BUGFIXING[/b]
-Backgrounds are no longer set to black by default

notes.title: Fixing the issue with black backgrounds
notes.content:
I have just been informed that new accounts have all the backgrounds turned to black by default. Especially with the game releasing in the past week this was defiantly not a bug that I would have wanted going out for all your first impressions. I have already fixed in the next update going live very soon but until then.

In the settings you can go to Video then change the Background Opacity to 100% (or anything else).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40967407/c62193aa5c30fdf0016533a8466502ccb1e1bf56.png[/img]

I do deeply apologise for anyone who had a bad impression due to this.

notes.title: What's going to be in update 1.1.0?
notes.content:
Many if you have expressed Interest to me in adding in more modifiers. Some that are just for fun and some to add additional challenge (and higher scores).

With this I wanted to properly add a way to add all these mods without just finding space for them every time I add one.

So coming in update 1.1.0 is the [b]Mod Quick Access[/b] and the [b]Mod Menu[/b].

The current 8 mod slots will be customizable and will have your favourite 8 mods quickly accessible. You will then be able to open up the larger menu and add select from the full list of modifiers.


I want to add arrow skins but this probably will be pushed back to 1.2.

In this updates will also include any bug fixes as well.

notes.title: Rhythium Season 1 - Storm Surge
notes.content:
[h3]Season 1[/h3]
With the launch of Rhythium coming in Late February its time to announce season 1 and the rewards it brings. Season 1 will launch March 1st (NZST).

Firstly for those that have yet to hear about this feature. Seasons are a month long event in Rhythium that competes players against each other in set conditions in the aim of getting an exclusive reward. 

[h3]Challenge[/h3]
Season 1 will feature the first song Rhythium developed, Dusk. 

Song: Dusk
Mods:
-Judgements
-Hardmode
-Nightcore

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40967407/0e3866c601f208f93acdf1973f38dca091e53b21.png[/img]

[h3]Rewards[/h3]
Now the part we have all been waiting for, Rewards. Rhythium will feature 2 tiers of rewards for season 1. Both of which will only be available during the event. 

All players who compete in the event will receive the 'Electro' player frame while the top 10% of player will receive the prestigious 'Volatage' player frame to show their skills during Season 1.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40967407/8cd8df1f1616096d1a6c8d469761833f11720224.png[/img]

[h3]Bonus[/h3]
To say thank you to everyone and to kick of season 1 all players will be able to use the 'Shock' skin after completing 5 default songs with B's or higher!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40967407/5631f61c3f70f7e4d9dbeb03d887ed4e261a8291.png[/img]

This is just the beginning of Rhythium. I hope that many of you get to enjoy competing against each other as Rhythium grows and new content is added!

[h3]Want more[/h3]
Join the discord to be up to date and offer feedback on upcoming updates
https://discord.gg/ZA8cwr2nv5

Rhythium is releasing late Feb with a full announcement coming soon!

notes.title: Introducing Ranked Seasons!
notes.content:
Introducing Ranked Seasons!

A new way to compete with the community. Every month a new season will begin and with it its own challenge of the month. 

Each month 1 song will be selected as well as 1 -  4 difficulty modifiers. On top of this judgements will also be enabled, meaning you can score 300, 100 or 50 points a hit depending on accuracy. Everyone's modifiers and song will be the same for the month. 

Adding judgements to this gamemode is designed to create a more competitive gamemode where people can really compete to see who is the best at the end of each month. I know this game is meant to be more chill so thats why i have created this as an avenue for more competitive players to have the option to play. 

Finally there will be rewards, at this current stage rewards are still being planned and im hoping to have an open disccusion with everyone about what they would love to see. 

While the seasons will reset each month. Season 1 will not start until the game releases so until then we will be having "Alpha seasons" which will be denoted as season 0.

Id love to hear what your ideas for rewards are:
(possible ideas)
-Stat on your profile (badges)
-profile banner
-skins
-titles
-currency used to buy skins/profile banners/titles

notes.title: Skin contest winners and the future of the game
notes.content:
[h2]Firstly, thank you everyone![/h2]
Firstly I would like to say thank you for those of you who submitted something for the skin contest. I would also like to thank all of you who have helped make Rhtyhium what it is today, especially those of you who have joined the discord. Thanks to all of you the game has changed so much during the alpha and you have inspired me to add so many new things.

[h2]Art contest winner![/h2]
With Rhythium's first ever skin contest coming to a close its time to announce the winner!

First place goes to TestDummy for their amazing 'Ultraviolet' skin!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40967407/51a9c3246480df5e87cfbb35b05567e3f2a840ca.png[/img]

Congratulations on winning a free copy of the game as well as having the skin included in the game!

The runner up skin was also by TestDummy and offered a cooler version of the default skin!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40967407/7b1f5d8f4d6abd6434b6dbeca10325ae626d41be.png[/img]

Thanks to everyone else who submitted something too and thanks to everyone who helped them in the community!.

[h2]The future[/h2]
Lastly I want to talk about the future of this game. 

Back when I released the alpha for Rhythium back in July the games scope was quite small. I wanted to make something that I enjoy and hoped you all would too. Many of you joined in the following months and offered amazing feedback. As the game grew I wanted to offer more to you all. With global leader boards, custom songs etc. 

This has expanded the scope of the game and I cant quite say I'm yet ready to stop working on all the amazing ideas you all have. At this rate the alpha may continue into 2022. This will allow me to add even more awesome suggestions and let me polish things even more.

[h2]Wanna join the alpha for free?[/h2]
To any of you who have read this and are interested in the game, please come join the discord and get a free alpha key. The more of you giving feedback on this game the more amazing things i can add.

Please join the discord below!

https://discord.gg/ZA8cwr2nv5

notes.title: Global Leaderboards!
notes.content:
Each song included with the game will now feature a global leaderboard. this will show off the top 10 players on each song.

So What are you waiting for it's time to aim for number 1!

In future this will be expanded to show much more than the top 10 so even if your not on the scoreboard, you might be soon! It still saves you to the scoreboard so don't feel discouraged.

Don't forget custom songs and a host of other major changes have been added since alpha began! So jump in and have a look!!

As always don't forget to join the discord if you haven't already
https://discord.gg/ZA8cwr2nv5
